name: Icon Toolbar
hint: Hover one icon, then slide to its neighbours.
description: A row of icon buttons with tooltips and toggle states. The first tooltip waits; moving to a neighbour shows its tooltip instantly. role=toolbar with roving focus (arrow keys and Home/End inside, Tab leaves; disabled buttons are skipped). Also exports IconButton.
intents: toolbar of icon buttons with tooltips
usage: Use for groups of compact actions: text editors, canvas tools, card action rows, media controls. Pass `items` (each needs an `id` and a `label`: the label is the tooltip and the accessible name) and `onSelect(id, item, event)`. Mark toggles with `toggle: true` and read their pressed set from `onChange(ids)`; control it with `value`, or seed it with `defaultValue`. Give the toolbar a `label` ("Text formatting") when the page has more than one. With no items it renders nothing.

keyboard.does: Moves focus into the toolbar, onto the last focused button (the first enabled one at first); the toolbar is a single Tab stop.
Moves to the previous or next enabled button, wrapping at the ends, and shows its tooltip.
Moves to the first or last enabled button.
Activates the focused button; a toggle flips its pressed state.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus.

screenReader: A toolbar named by `label` (or aria-label). Each button is named by its item's `label`, and the tooltip is hidden from screen readers so the name is not read twice; toggle items report aria-pressed and shortcuts are exposed as aria-keyshortcuts.

Disables every button (each item can also set `disabled`).
Other attributes (id, aria-*, data-*) go to the toolbar root <div>; className and style too.

Width and height of each button: sm 30px (a dense panel), md 38px, lg 46px (touch-first and media controls); the bar adds 4px around them. On a phone or a touch screen every button is at least 44px. A number sets it in px exactly.
